## Behavior and acceptance criteria

Describe the problem and observable result. Link the issue or specification.

## Validation evidence

List commands and results, including unavailable checks and the revision/digest tested.

## Independent review

Identify the separate reviewer/session, scope reviewed, findings and disposition. If unavailable, say so; self-review is not independent review.

## Conditional operational notes

For API/data/platform changes: compatibility, migration, rollback, cost, permission, and backup/restore implications. Otherwise mark not applicable.
